lines.text: David stayed in Ziklag two days, and on the third day a man came from Saul's camp.
The man said he found Saul leaning on his spear on Mount Carmel, killed him, and took his crown.
David tore his clothes, and all his men did the same, and they mourned, wept and fasted until evening.
David learned the man was an Amalekite, and he had a young man execute him for killing the LORD's anointed.
David ordered the sons of Benjamin taught the Song of the Bow, saying to tell the news not in Gath.
